fields.description: Rixos Hotel & Residences Dubai Islands is a Nakheel and Excelsior Real Estate development combining branded homes with a waterfront hospitality setting. The original release includes apartments, four-bedroom duplexes, beach houses and ten standalone villas. It is distinct from later Rixos phases with their own delivery dates and terms.

overview: The residential programme combines indoor leisure facilities and outdoor waterfront spaces. Homeowners should distinguish residential facilities covered by service charges from optional hospitality purchases: the brochure describes paid supplementary services and discounted hotel passes rather than unrestricted free all-inclusive hotel use.
research.locationNote: Nakheel’s original announcement places the project on Dubai Islands in a secluded cove with access to a 700-metre beach. Confirm the actual building, beach rights and orientation. Dubai Islands is not yet mapped in the existing location catalogue.
research.priceNote: Property Finder displays AED 2.6m for the original release and labels developer inventory sold out. This is a historical starting reference, not a live available unit. Villas, duplexes, later phases and resales have different pricing.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% at launch, 60% during construction and 20% at handover. Morgans’ project page breaks construction into six 10% instalments in December 2023, March 2024, July 2024, November 2024, March 2025 and September 2025. These are attributed historical dates; the stages below are not a newly verified developer offer.
research.handoverNote: The original Property Finder record reports December 2026, expressed as Q4 2026. This is an estimated original-release programme. Later Rixos-branded phases have separate completion targets; obtain the selected building’s contractual date.

facts.label: Services and charges
facts.value: The brochure puts core residential services within annual service charges and lists supplementary services for separate purchase. The actual charge and service agreement need confirmation.

facts.label: Ownership benefits
facts.value: Accor owner benefits are conditional on continued ownership and an annual fee within service charges. Participating properties and availability restrictions apply; hotel access is not automatically unlimited.

facts.label: Layout scope
facts.value: The A1 duplex drawing shows a private terrace pool. Its extensive outdoor area is included in the printed total, so total area should not be compared with another apartment’s enclosed suite alone.
